2798ae04.text:
ATTENTION:

Remain Silent! Don't look around at anyone! Someone could be watching you this very moment.

My name is Alamar Grimm, NAKARN. I train those willing to seek knowledge and greater power from... worlds beyond. I've been asked to get in touch with you discretely and inform you that I can train you further in a real form of magic.

When you can, come find me in the back of Anvilmar.

-Alamar Grimm, $C Trainer
2798ae04.title: Tainted Memorandum

11028|ea44f66d.name: Jemma Quikswitch
11028|ea44f66d.text: I heard the new Henweigh 6000 will be rolling off the assembly line soon. I can barely contain my excitement!

11065|03886821.name: Thonys Pillarstone
11065|03886821.text: Ah, ye're an inquisitive one, are ye'? Excellent! Pay close attention, this just might save yer skin when the goin' gets rough!

11065|9c1c73ea.name: Thonys Pillarstone
11065|9c1c73ea.text: There are ways to strengthen steel beyond the hammer and forge, young wanderer. Care to learn more?

1247|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Belm
1247|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1699|0c543544.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
1699|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1699|b48f927f.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
1699|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

1703|112fe3e7.name: Uthrar Threx
1703|112fe3e7.text: Welcome to me shop. What can I do for ye'?

1703|d69277e0.name: Uthrar Threx
1703|d69277e0.text: Excellent! I've been hopin' for a new student. Well, let's get started right away then!

2326|a28d29e1.name: Thamner Pol
2326|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

2878|4ef1d72e.name: Peria Lamenur
2878|4ef1d72e.text: Ah friend, I only help hunters and their pets.

460|86b6c1ef.name: Alamar Grimm
460|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5172|86b6c1ef.name: Briarthorn
5172|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5595|3804779b.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|3804779b.text: Which class trainer might ye be looking for?

5595|3e1ee680.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|3e1ee680.text:
Ye might not know it, but in addition to being a skilled tailor, Jormund is also a slayer of giants!  Why he must have overheard a few of us sharing stories when he shouted that he'd killed seven with one blow!  

Ye should pay him a visit at his store on the north side of The Great Forge an' see if he'll tell ye the tale!

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

5595|f3452b83.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|f3452b83.text: Where better to look for a dark and brooding lot, than the dark section of Ironforge, aptly named The Forlorn Cavern.  Thistleheart is sure to be found there, likely summoning some manner of vile creature to do his bidding.

5612|86b6c1ef.name: Gimrizz Shadowcog
5612|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

6328|721fd095.name: Dannie Fizzwizzle
6328|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

6376|721fd095.name: Wren Darkspring
6376|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

658|003beda2.name: Sten Stoutarm
658|003beda2.text: Ah, well aren't you a sturdy-looking one? Perhaps you can assist me with a thing or two. Not much help around here except for green apprentices, and they've other things to worry about.

836|b62f5856.name: Durnan Furcutter
836|b62f5856.text: I sell the finest cloth and leather garb this side of the valley!

1599-accept.name: Alamar Grimm
1599-accept.text:
You must be the new $c everyone's been whispering about. Must be someone's taken a liking to you if they've asked me to take time away from my research to start your training.

Don't worry, I won't hold it against you.

The simplest of the summoning spells you will learn is that of the imp. Before I impart this to you, however, you must prove that you have the necessary magical and physical ability.

Bring me three feather charms from the frostmane novices from the cave to the southwest.
1599-accept.title: Beginnings

1599-complete.name: Alamar Grimm
1599-complete.text:
Very good, very good! You've done well, $N. Perhaps the interest that is being shown in you is deserved, after all.

That'll be for the others to decide--assuming your imp doesn't overpower you and nip your career in the bud. For now, I'm satisfied that you'll probably survive your first few months as a $c.

A word about the imp, $N. As a $r knows, don't let its size fool you, its magic can be very dangerous.
1599-complete.title: Beginnings

1599-progress.name: Alamar Grimm
1599-progress.text: Those feather charms the novices carry have some sort of magical power to them. It will be interesting to research them. I wouldn't have expected it from the trolls.
1599-progress.title: Beginnings

170-accept.name: Balir Frosthammer
170-accept.text:
I hope you're here to lend us a hand, $c. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.

I hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.

And that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west! 

We're a bit shorthanded here, lad, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.
170-accept.title: A New Threat

170-complete.name: Balir Frosthammer
170-complete.text: If the problems we've had here are indicative of what is happening elsewhere in our lands, by Magni's beard, we have some troubles ahead of us! I can only hope that the king and Senate are taking steps to deal with the threat the troggs pose.
170-complete.title: A New Threat

179-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-accept.text:
What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?

I'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.

I need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?
179-accept.title: Dwarven Outfitters

179-complete.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-complete.text: Ah! Wonderful. The wolf meat should do nicely. Oh, don't worry, $N, I wouldn't forget my part of the bargain. Here, one of these should fit you.
179-complete.title: Dwarven Outfitters

179-progress.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-progress.text: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
179-progress.title: Dwarven Outfitters

182-accept.name: Grelin Whitebeard
182-accept.text:
My brother Senir and I were sent to different parts of Dun Morogh to investigate the threat posed by the trolls. The Senate has its hands full with the troggs, so they've no need for further annoyances.

From what I've seen, the trolls aren't well situated here in Coldridge Valley--mostly the southern cave. I'd say that the army will not be necessary. A few strong arms should be more than enough.

Perhaps you'd like to assist in this endeavor? I have the authority to offer compensation for your help.
182-accept.title: The Troll Cave

182-complete.name: Grelin Whitebeard
182-complete.text:
Argh! Those Light-blasted trolls!

<He takes a few breaths and seems to settle down... a bit.>

A group of them came in the night and stole my journal! I knew better than to trust that good-for-nothing appr...
182-complete.title: The Troll Cave

183-accept.name: Talin Keeneye
183-accept.text:
Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh?

Though, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting.

Long story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.
183-accept.title: The Boar Hunter

183-complete.name: Talin Keeneye
183-complete.text: Excellent! I can go back to my... leisurely... hunting now. Thank you, $N.
183-complete.title: The Boar Hunter

2160-accept.name: Hands Springsprocket
2160-accept.text:
Hey! You look like a hearty adventurer. If you're planning on braving the pass, do you suppose you could bring a package to the inn in Kharanos?

You were planning on stopping at the inn, right? If you make it through the pass, you'll definitely want to take a breather there.

Anyways, bring this to Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant. I can't get through the pass myself, and it'll be days until a Mountaineer escort comes through!
2160-accept.title: Supplies to Tannok

2160-complete.name: Tannok Frosthammer
2160-complete.text:
Ah, at last, the supplies from Hands! I was beginning to worry, we've had scarce word from Anvilmar ever since the troggs overran the pass.

Thanks for bringing this to me, $N. And please, make yourself comfortable. You must be tired after your journey.
2160-complete.title: Supplies to Tannok

2160-progress.name: Tannok Frosthammer
2160-progress.text: Hi there! Come in, take a seat by the fire and warm yourself with a flagon of ale.
2160-progress.title: Supplies to Tannok

218-accept.name: Grelin Whitebeard
218-accept.text:
My journal! They took it away to the cave. The one that had it... It was a big brute with some odd markings on his skin and face. I didn't get a much better look than that.

You've had some luck with the trolls, maybe you could go get it back for me?
218-accept.title: The Stolen Journal

218-complete.name: Grelin Whitebeard
218-complete.text:
Wonderful, $N! Many thanks for retrieving my notebook. Well, it would seem that the troll situation here in Coldridge Valley is under control and not much cause for worry.

After I put the finishing touches on my report, I'll need someone to courier it to my brother Senir.
218-complete.title: The Stolen Journal

233-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
233-accept.text:
Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, lad? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.

They're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.

What do you say?
233-accept.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

233-complete.name: Talin Keeneye
233-complete.text:
Thank you, I've been waiting for these letters for quite some time...

Unfortunately, these letters aren't all for me. This one is addressed to Grelin Whitebeard. He's not too far away if you'd like to deliver it to him.
233-complete.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

233-progress.name: Talin Keeneye
233-progress.text: Yes? Do you have something for me?
233-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-accept.name: Talin Keeneye
234-accept.text: If I remember correctly, Grelin's camp is down the road to the southeast. No doubt he'll be eager to get his mail.
234-accept.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-complete.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-complete.text: Ahh, excellent. It's been a while since I received word from Ironforge. Ach, these letters from me mum warm my heart. Here, not fair you don't get some readin', too. Take one of these manuals we have lyin' around.
234-complete.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-progress.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-progress.text: Is there something I can help you with?
234-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

282-accept.name: Grelin Whitebeard
282-accept.text:
I was planning on sending my apprentice to my brother Senir with my report, but I would feel much better were it placed in more... reliable hands. That is, of course, if you wouldn't mind?

Hmm... you'll have to take the tunnel to get to Kharanos.

Speak with Mountaineer Thalos before going through the tunnel. It's completely infested with troggs now.

Follow the road back to Anvilmar, then keep heading east to the tunnel, Thalos is stationed nearby.
282-accept.title: Senir's Observations

282-complete.name: Mountaineer Thalos
282-complete.text:
Hm, well, if Whitebeard is sending you to Dun Morogh on important business, I can't very well stop you, can I?

At least let me provide you with some advice and directions.
282-complete.title: Senir's Observations

282-progress.name: Mountaineer Thalos
282-progress.text:
Hail! Have a care, $N, the tunnel to Dun Morogh is infested with troggs and is not safe for travel.

If you haven't any pressing business in Dun Morogh, I'll have to ask you to remain in Anvilmar until the tunnel is safer.
282-progress.title: Senir's Observations

287-accept.name: Senir Whitebeard
287-accept.text:
I'm behind on my report, and could use your help, $N. I just managed to find where the trolls are holed up, but I saw so many trolls, I was afraid to go in.

Here's what I need... Go down to the cave, poke around inside, kill a few of the trolls, then come back here.

Take the road north out of Kharanos, when you get to the bridge, follow the frozen river west until you reach Iceflow Lake. You'll find Brewnall Village on the west bank. The Hold is southwest of the village.
287-accept.title: Frostmane Hold

310-accept.name: Marleth Barleybrew
310-accept.text:
I have to admit, those Thunderbrews make some good drinks. But they need to learn that theirs isn't the only decent brew! Maybe you can help me teach them that lesson...

Here, take this barrel of Barleybrew Scalder. Sneak into the basement of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos and switch it with one of their barrels of Thunder Ale. Then we'll see how their patrons like my brew over theirs!

And if the barrels are guarded, then you might have to distract the guard...
310-accept.title: Bitter Rivals

3115-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
3115-accept.text:
While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the $c trainer Alamar. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

And watch yerself, $N, your kind ain't too trusted 'round these parts.
3115-accept.title: Tainted Memorandum

3115-complete.name: Alamar Grimm
3115-complete.text:
But none of that matters. What matters is that you've seen your own Holy Light! You know where power truly comes from. You realize that having our own allies is much more... prudent. Special allies. Allies that, no matter the task, will obey till their last breath.

And that's where I come in, $N. I can train you in the beginnings of those special powers. Seek me out often and I will do what I can to teach you more spells.
3115-complete.title: Tainted Memorandum

3115-progress.name: Alamar Grimm
3115-progress.text:
Wonderful! You got my memorandum obviously.

Ignore the fools around you, $N. The Holy Light?! The sword and shield?! These aren't paths for ones as open minded as us. Look at what "normal" magic did to our home. Coupled with  those damned tinkerers, our race almost became extinct. And now we have to rely on the dwarves-- they'd rather spend time allying with humans than help us rebuild our own home. We're like second-class citizens. Have you seen the way they look at us?
3115-progress.title: Tainted Memorandum

313-accept.name: Pilot Stonegear
313-accept.text:
Driving a Siege Engine isn't for everyone.  It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both!  How about you?  How's your mettle?  Want to prove it to me?

Well...I'm looking to make my engine, Trollplow, a little more cozy.  How about you get me a heap of Wendigo Manes from the Grizzled Den, west of Kharanos.  Those manes would make a great rug for Trollplow's inside deck!
313-accept.title: The Grizzled Den

313-complete.name: Pilot Stonegear
313-complete.text: Ah yes, these manes will work great!  You show a lot of grit, $C - I wager we'll see great things from you.
313-complete.title: The Grizzled Den

313-progress.name: Pilot Stonegear
313-progress.text: Hey, $N.  Been to the Grizzled Den yet?  Those Wendigos can be fierce.
313-progress.title: The Grizzled Den

315-accept.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-accept.text:
I'm on a quest, a quest to make the perfect stout.  I know I can do it -- brewing's in my blood.  I just need to find the right recipe...

The Frostmane trolls grow a plant, shimmerweed, high up in the hills to the east.  They use it in their strange, tribal rituals.  We dwarves haven't found much use for it, but it has a unique taste...and I want to experiment with it in my brews!

Get me some shimmerweed from Frostmane seers, or swipe it from the trolls' shimmerweed baskets.
315-accept.title: The Perfect Stout

317-accept.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
317-accept.text:
I'm preparing to start a mission for the Siege Brigade.  It's a long one, and I need to stock Jetsteam with a month's worth of supplies.  So while Steelgrill is working on my tank, can you do some hunting for me?

I'll need some fur for bedding, and boar meat for food.  You can get meat from boars and fur from the bears... you can find them both in the snow fields south of the Grizzled Den.
317-accept.title: Stocking Jetsteam

317-complete.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
317-complete.text: By Magni's beard, you sure did a lot of hunting!!  Thank you, $N.
317-complete.title: Stocking Jetsteam

317-progress.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
317-progress.text: Preparations are going well.  How goes your hunting?
317-progress.title: Stocking Jetsteam

318-accept.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
318-accept.text:
Rejold Barleybrew experiments with his brews.  Some of them taste good, some bad, and some...well, some will lay all but the stoutest dwarf flat.

He lives at Brewnall Village, west of Kharanos, and one of his drinks, Evershine, is what I want.  It'll help keep me warm while I'm on the cold road.

And...the blessed stuff burns so hot I can throw it in Jetsteam's furnace for a burst of power!  That little tactic has gotten me out of more than one tight spot.
318-accept.title: Evershine

318-complete.name: Rejold Barleybrew
318-complete.text: Bellowfiz needs some of my Evershine?  Hm...all right.
318-complete.title: Evershine

319-accept.name: Rejold Barleybrew
319-accept.text:
I have a cask of Evershine handy, but...can you do me a favor?  Brewnall village could use a hand against the wild animals that wander the nearby snows.  Sometimes they wander close.

We're not afraid of these bears and cats and boars - no self respecting dwarf would be - but if you can take care of those animals for us, then we'd have more time for our crafting and brewing.
319-accept.title: A Favor for Evershine

3361-accept.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-accept.text:
We drove the troggs out of Gnomeregan, but then it all went so horribly wrong!  Now our home is completely irradiated, and we gnomes have been scattered all over Dun Morogh.

In my haste to get away from the radiation, I lost all my personal belongings and tools.  It was the trolls that got them.  They stole my chest, my box, and my bucket of bolts!  They took them back to their camps southwest of Anvilmar.

I'm no adventurer - could you find my things and bring them here to me, please?
3361-accept.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3361-complete.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-complete.text: Huzzah, you've found them!  You're an absolute savior, my friend.  Here, it's not much, but it's something for the trouble I've put you through!  Thank you!
3361-complete.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3361-progress.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-progress.text:
Oh goodness $N, this town is not well suited for the likes of me.  There are as many nasty creatures here as there were in Gnomeregan before the accident!

Do you have my belongings?  If you don't, then who knows what the trolls have done with them now...
3361-progress.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3364-accept.name: Nori Pridedrift
3364-accept.text:
Gah!  I was supposed to get this delicious scalding mornbrew to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar a while ago now, but I had to deliver one to Grelin here first.  I'll never make it to Anvilmar before the brew runs cold!

You look fast.  Maybe you can make it.  This cup will only stay hot for five more minutes, and Durnan didn't order "chilly" mornbrew, so get going.  Anvilmar is to the northeast, a settlement dug into the mountain.

Thanks, $N, and don't forget to bring me back my mug!
3364-accept.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3364-complete.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-complete.text: Ah good, now this will hit the spot.  Allow me to take a small break while I enjoy this scalding mornbrew!
3364-complete.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3364-progress.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-progress.text: Aye, I'm Durnan Furcutter.  You have something for me?
3364-progress.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3365-accept.name: Durnan Furcutter
3365-accept.text:
Now that hit the spot!  Nothing like a piping hot - nay, SCALDING mornbrew on a cold winter's day to warm your cackles of yer soul.

Here ya go $N - be a pal and take this empty mug back to Nori for me, would ya now.
3365-accept.title: Bring Back the Mug

3365-complete.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-complete.text:
Excellent, $N!  You'd be surprised how many couriers I meet who forget to do something as simple as bring back the mug.  Mugs don't grow on trees, or so they tell me!

Here's a little something for the effort.  Thanks again for your help.
3365-complete.title: Bring Back the Mug

3365-progress.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-progress.text: I trust the scalding mornbrew got to Durnan on time!  Did you remember to bring me back my mug?
3365-progress.title: Bring Back the Mug

384-accept.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-accept.text:
Nothing my tavern patrons enjoy more than some Beer Basted Boar Ribs!  Only problem is, the local trapper who used to bring me supplies enlisted in the King's Army to help with the war on the Alliance front. 

Maybe you can help me out?  If you bring me six crag boar ribs and a Rhapsody Malt from the tavern here, I'll give you the family recipe for my famous Beer Basted Boar Ribs, not to mention a free sample!  The secret's in the Malt!
384-accept.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

400-accept.name: Tharek Blackstone
400-accept.text:
Beldin Steelgrill owns the local mechanic shop, and he's the best siege engine tech there is!  But he's not forgiving to his tools.  I swear he almost breaks more arclight spanners than we can supply him with!

We just filled his last order for tools.  If you deliver it to him I'm sure he'll make it worth the effort.

His shop, Steelgrill's Depot, is just northeast of Kharanos.  And it's a local haunt for veteran siege engine pilots, so keep your ears open for opportunities while you're there.
400-accept.title: Tools for Steelgrill

400-complete.name: Beldin Steelgrill
400-complete.text:
You have my tools?  Well done, lad, well done!  I just broke my last fang-ratchet an hour ago and I need one of those to finish repairs on Pilot Stonegear's siege engine.  You did a good thing by lugging those tools here, $N.

Here, take these coins for your help.
400-complete.title: Tools for Steelgrill

400-progress.name: Beldin Steelgrill
400-progress.text:
Hm?  You look a little young to be a siege engine pilot.  But no matter...do you need something fixed?

Well take a number and get comfortable.  I'm working on a couple engines right now and won't have time for another job for at least a few days.

Or, were you here for something else...?
400-progress.title: Tools for Steelgrill

412-accept.name: Wan
412-accept.text:
Upon further analysis of the Gnomeregan situation, it would appear as though we not only failed to eradicate the troggs but we also happened to turn most of the gnomish race into horrific, mindless, evil-doing leper gnomes.

Ozzie and I plan to reverse the horrible leper effect with our latest invention: The Recombobulator.  The machine is almost complete but we are in dire need of some Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears.  Retrieve some from the leper gnomes out front of Gnomeregan for us.
412-accept.title: Operation Recombobulation

420-accept.name: Mountaineer Thalos
420-accept.text:
The troggs in the tunnel are extremely hostile, and haven't shown any hesitation in attacking travelers through the tunnel. You seem tough enough, though, so you should probably be safe.

Directions? If you're going to speak with Senir, you'll find him in Kharanos.

Make your way through the tunnel, and after you come out on the other side, just keep following the road, it'll run right into Kharanos.
420-accept.title: Senir's Observations

420-complete.name: Senir Whitebeard
420-complete.text:
What's this? Ah, my brother's report. Hmm...

I told him to be sparing with the use of the King's name, but he didn't listen. No harm, I suppose, though it's sure to ruffle some feathers in the Senate. Not that those weren't some feathers that needed ruffling! Hah!

Nonetheless, I guess that means that I should send my report on to Ironforge as well, but I must admit I'm a bit behind. Bloody cold.

I should have some work for you later, if you're interested.
420-complete.title: Senir's Observations

420-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
420-progress.text: How are you? Like to share a drink with me, perhaps? Not much else to do in the cold.
420-progress.title: Senir's Observations

5541-accept.name: Loslor Rudge
5541-accept.text:
Hegnar Rumbleshot sells guns off the road to Anvilmar.  Riflemen and mortar teams spend a lot of time practicing out near his shop, and he's always needing fresh ammunition.

But... the last crate of ammo I sent him got lost along the way.  My courier said he was camped near the Grizzled Den when wendigo chased him away... and the fool left Rumbleshot's ammo behind!

$N, can you get that ammo and take it to Rumbleshot?  He's been waiting on it and I'm sure he's running low.
5541-accept.title: Ammo for Rumbleshot

5541-complete.name: Hegnar Rumbleshot
5541-complete.text:
Great, more ammo!  Old Loslor's shipment finally came through!  The ammo might be late, but just like my grand daddy used to tell me: late's better than never!

Thank you much, $N.  I already have buyers eager for this stuff!
5541-complete.title: Ammo for Rumbleshot

5541-progress.name: Hegnar Rumbleshot
5541-progress.text: I hope you're not here for ammo, because I'm almost out!
5541-progress.title: Ammo for Rumbleshot

95041-accept.name: Jemma Quikswitch
95041-accept.text:
Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... our greatest accomplishments are in those files.

It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.

The cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot...
95041-accept.title: Data Hoarders

96047-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96047-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
96047-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

96047-complete.name: Thamner Pol
96047-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96047-complete.title: Camping 101: First Aid

96055-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96055-accept.text:
Looks to me like you've gained some skill in herbalism. Picking flowers isn't just for dilly-dallying, you know. It can be useful... and profitable.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Incense Candle for your camp. High spirits are a key component to keeping healers and spellcasters in the fight, and an Incense Candle can provide a boost that magic users will surely appreciate.
96055-accept.title: Camping 101: Herbalism

96056-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96056-accept.text:
Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.
96056-accept.title: Camping 101: Skinning

96056-complete.name: Balthus Stoneflayer
96056-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96056-complete.title: Camping 101: Skinning

96057-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96057-accept.text:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
96057-accept.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

96059-accept.name: Thonys Pillarstone
96059-accept.text:
Now that you've begun your journey into being an enchanter, I reckon I can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp once you've learned the ropes.

It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
96059-accept.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

96608-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96608-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96608-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96608-complete.name: Eric Brighthammer
96608-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96608-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96628-accept.name: Mountaineer Thalos
96628-accept.text:
Wait, $N. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.

My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?
96628-accept.title: The Adventurer

96628-complete.name: Eric Brighthammer
96628-complete.text:
You say these are from the mountaineers? Aye, I could use them. Thank you, $c.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96628-complete.title: The Adventurer

96628-progress.name: Eric Brighthammer
96628-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96628-progress.title: The Adventurer

96629-accept.name: Eric Brighthammer
96629-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96629-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96629-complete.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
96629-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96629-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96629-progress.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
96629-progress.text: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.
96629-progress.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97277-accept.name: Grund Drokda
97277-accept.text:
Oi, had me back turned gettin' the boar roast ready when I heard me pal Gozwin screamin' fer his life!

Wicked fangs and a blur are all I saw when I turned. Such huge paws! A snow leopard was draggin' its gnomish catch away. I grabbed me shotgun and fired above the beast. It dropped him and sprinted off.

Luckily, it hadn't done more than give ol' Goz some deep scratches.

Head back to camp in the northwestern hills and retrieve Gozwin's Mechanic's Log. Kill that snow leopard too if you see it!
97277-accept.title: Grund and Gozwin

97277-complete.name: Grund Drokda
97277-complete.text:
Aye, I'm not surprised to hear that snow leopard was makin' a meal of the boar we were fixin' fer roastin'!

Goz will have one less thing to stress about now that you brought back his log book. Maybe now he can focus all his energy on gettin' back on his feet.

Thanks, $N. Take a little something as a token of my appreciation, fer makin' the trek, and fer protectin' the hills.
97277-complete.title: Grund and Gozwin

97277-progress.name: Grund Drokda
97277-progress.text: Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home!
97277-progress.title: Grund and Gozwin

98319-accept.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
98319-accept.text:
It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here.

If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid.

Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some of the beasts while yer at it.
98319-accept.title: Secure the Mountain

98319-complete.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
98319-complete.text:
Ach, the fool...

Thank ye for the help, $N. Guess we have our report.
98319-complete.title: Secure the Mountain

98321-accept.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-accept.text:
Hoha! Good to see a $r who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!

Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.
98321-accept.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98321-complete.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-complete.text: Now that's more like it! With these shipments we'll get the forge back up and runnin' in no time!
98321-complete.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98321-progress.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-progress.text: Wendigos are nasty beasties. It's just good all the miners made it out of the Grizzled Den in one piece!
98321-progress.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98322-accept.name: Senir Whitebeard
98322-accept.text:
Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.

Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.

If you're already going to be out and about, what say you check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!
98322-accept.title: Secure the Mountain

98322-complete.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
98322-complete.text:
Ol' Whitebeard sent ya, aye?

I got his report, alright. This whole situation's a mess!
98322-complete.title: Secure the Mountain

98323-accept.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
98323-accept.text:
Hopefully ye put down a fair number of the mongrels while you were in there. Shame about Cornelius, though.

From what you described, there's not much to report other than the cave is a lost cause. Whitebeard's not gonna like that answer, but I'm not darin' sendin' anybody else into that death trap.

Feel free tae pass along the message, $N. I'm not leavin' this spot till the mountain's secure.
98323-accept.title: Secure the Mountain

98323-complete.name: Senir Whitebeard
98323-complete.text:
Completely overrun? Why am I not surprised.

Well, that's going in the report too.

<Senir folds Gretchen's letter into his pile of notes>
98323-complete.title: Secure the Mountain

98323-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
98323-progress.text:
Ah, you're back just in time.

What's the matter, lad? You look like you've seen a ghost.
98323-progress.title: Secure the Mountain

98326-accept.name: Gretta Ganter
98326-accept.text:
Do ye know how hard it is to fish on a frozen lake? My poor husband, Paxton, has been out in the middle of it for days and we barely have a single sack to show fer it.

Well, we DID have a sack to show fer it. Until the thrice-damned wendigo attacked me and made off with our haul. It'll take us weeks to fish all that back up! If that loudmouth Frosthowl didn't scare 'em all off, anyway.

Do us a favor and get it back, aye? Drooling brute is hiding somewhere deep in the Grizzled Den to the southeast.
98326-accept.title: Frosthowl

99158-accept.name: Maxan Anvol
99158-accept.text:
There's a priest out in the mountains that belongs to an organization called the Argent Dawn. They're a holy group that is dedicated to finding and destroying the unholy and unnatural.

Father Gavin though, he's mostly the type that seeks to help and heal everyone rather than grab a weapon. He's fixed up an old building to serve as a rest spot for travelers and called it Misty Pine Refuge. I've got a shipment of holy candles that I need to get him. Could you bring them to him if you're going that way?
99158-accept.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99158-complete.name: Father Gavin
99158-complete.text:
Ah. Candles from Ironforge. 

While I am mostly able to live independently in my hermitage, there are a few key things that I appreciate from the city and the pious.
99158-complete.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99158-progress.name: Father Gavin
99158-progress.text: Why did the Light guide you here today?
99158-progress.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99159-accept.name: Father Gavin
99159-accept.text:
My hearth is open to warm any soul, but I'd like to ask you to help me if you could.

I simply need more firewood. It is something I would normally do myself, but I have been preoccupied by other tasks.
99159-accept.title: Finding Warmth

99159-complete.name: Father Gavin
99159-complete.text:
Ah, perfect. These will do--any that are too wet to use right now I will leave to dry.

Now, if you're willing, I have more tasks I could use help with.
99159-complete.title: Finding Warmth

99159-progress.name: Father Gavin
99159-progress.text: Light guide you on your tasks.
99159-progress.title: Finding Warmth

99160-accept.name: Father Gavin
99160-accept.text:
You may have noticed the elementals nearby. A shelf of rock and ice fell from the mountain peaks a few days ago and riled them up.

These frozen mountains are already treacherous for the average dwarf or human without the elements taking form. I am not one for fighting anymore--so any of the spirits you can kill would help make the road safer.
99160-accept.title: Rime's Wrath

99160-complete.name: Father Gavin
99160-complete.text: I wish we could have simply placated them. Unfortunately it was beyond my knowledge and they were too dangerous to leave unchecked.
99160-complete.title: Rime's Wrath

99161-accept.name: Father Gavin
99161-accept.text:
I noticed that the first elemental that appeared after the rockslide was larger than its peers. And from what I can tell, it has been the source of occasional weather changes and other minor slides.

I've been calling it 'Avala', if you could kill it and retrieve the core as proof, I will reward you.
99161-accept.title: Rime's Wrath

99161-complete.name: Father Gavin
99161-complete.text: Light bless you, $c. Your efforts make this area much safer and hopefully will prevent unnecessary deaths.
99161-complete.title: Rime's Wrath

99162-accept.name: Father Gavin
99162-accept.text:
Even mountaineers from Ironforge have to keep their wits about them when traversing through the peaks of Dun Morogh. Falling snow and ice often spells the end of some more novice members' lives.

After a slide, I usually try to find any sign of survivors or victims--while praying to the Light that there's nothing to be found. But with the elements acting up, I've held off wandering too far. If you could look for some lost mountaineers and bring me their rifles, I will return them to Ironforge.
99162-accept.title: Treacherous Cold

99162-complete.name: Father Gavin
99162-complete.text: The mountaineers engrave their names on the stock of their rifles. It helps identify them should something happen. I'll send these back to Ironforge--there someone will pass them on to any family.
99162-complete.title: Treacherous Cold
